title: Sub-agent first
summary: The main session only dispatches and reports; the work runs in background agents that write progress files.
why: A main thread full of tool rows hides the one decision you need to make. Moving the work into sub-agents keeps the session readable and lets several jobs run at once.

items.title: Main session only dispatches
items.does: Adds the banner rule that every file and shell tool runs inside a sub-agent, and the /done step that dispatches the ritual to one agent.
items.why: The author once allowed a single quick read in the main thread; the exception spread and the console filled with tool rows again. Only a mechanical rule held.
items.notes: Off by default: it changes how you work with Claude more than anything else here.

items.title: Main-thread tool guard
items.does: Copies kit_subagent_first.py and adds a PreToolUse hook that denies file and shell tools in the main thread with a one-line reason.
items.why: A rule that depends on remembering it fails on a busy day; a hook makes it hold every time.

items.title: Status from background counters
items.does: Adds the rule that work runs as background agents and commands, so the session shows compact running counts instead of a long foreground turn.
items.why: An expanding foreground activity row has to be opened and scrolled before you can see whether anything is wrong.

items.title: Progress file per long task
items.does: Adds the rule that work over five minutes writes a small JSON progress file after each step: percent, step, estimate, status and time.
items.why: You see how far a job is and when it will end while it runs, and a job that stops writing is caught as a failure early instead of at the end.

items.title: Old progress files to the Recycle Bin
items.does: Installs a small tool that lists finished progress files older than seven days and, with --apply, sends them to the Recycle Bin.
items.why: Stale rows pushed live ones off the status line; pruning them by status and age keeps only what still matters, and the Recycle Bin keeps the prune undoable.

items.title: Higher concurrent sub-agent cap
items.does: Sets CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONCURRENT_SUBAGENTS in your Claude settings to the number you choose (10 unless you change it).
items.why: Sub-agent-first work fans out wide; the author runs a much higher cap than the default.
